image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a chiton (marine mollusk) clinging to a rough, grey rocky substrate. The chiton has an oval shape with a distinct reddish-pink leathery girdle surrounding eight overlapping dorsal plates. The plates feature intricate wavy patterns in white and dark brown/black against a pinkish background. The texture appears hard and calcified on the plates, while the girdle looks slightly softer but still tough.
